humanAcceptance.evidence: Dave tested the SHA-keyed local staged preview at 95788909eab9727ed1dc82d7ef9a9d64d519830e and repeatedly instructed Codex to publish Pass 69. The immutable GitHub Actions preview at e1b22b7c2450f2eb818980d6889123133db2d5f7 contains the same approved runtime and release-shell bytes; intervening changes are restricted to acceptance, test, and process files and are checked by approval parity.

requirements.summary: Publish the exact locally approved Pass 69 gameplay candidate
requirements.expected: Production serves the exact gameplay, weapon, support, mobile and visual candidate that Dave tested locally at source SHA 95788909eab9727ed1dc82d7ef9a9d64d519830e.
requirements.falsifier: Production uses another source SHA, the staged runtime digest changes after approval, or a runtime/release-shell path changes after the approved preview.

evidence.note: Dave tested the SHA-keyed local staged preview and explicitly authorized publication of this exact candidate.

requirements.summary: The public chooser exposes exactly Pass 69 and stable Pass 63 WebGL
requirements.expected: The root chooser has exactly two selectable cards: Pass 69 at channels/the-big-one and Pass 63 Stable WebGL at channels/pass63-rollback; Pass 67.1 is retained internally but is not selectable.
requirements.falsifier: A third card appears, Pass 67.1 is selectable, either required card is absent, or either card routes to the wrong subtree.

evidence.note: The served staged chooser requires exactly two cards and verifies both direct destinations.
Dave inspected the local production-style chooser showing only Pass 69 and Pass 63 Stable WebGL.

requirements.summary: Current player-facing branding is Pass 69 rather than The Big One
requirements.expected: The chooser, runtime identity, command shell and current project information present the release as Pass 69 without current The Big One branding.
requirements.falsifier: The chooser or current runtime shell still presents The Big One, a versioned 69.3 public label replaces Pass 69, or player-facing release surfaces disagree.

evidence.command: npx vitest run src/release-topology.test.ts src/project-map.test.ts src/ui/pass64-shell.test.ts
evidence.note: Release identity, chooser copy and current runtime shell are pinned to Pass 69 and reject The Big One branding.
The real staged chooser and Pass 69 route display Pass 69 and reject current The Big One copy.
The owner-reviewed chooser visibly identifies the candidate as Pass 69.

requirements.summary: Stable Pass 63 WebGL remains pinned to its approved source
requirements.expected: The selectable fallback is rebuilt only from Pass 63 source ac85e9b8b46cc2370aee903d564ecf3c4682b24c and is staged at channels/pass63-rollback with separate provenance.
requirements.falsifier: The fallback uses a different source, is rebuilt with Pass 69 shared runtime bytes, loses provenance, or the stable card routes elsewhere.

evidence.note: The Pass 63 source SHA and route remain exact while the public config maps the stable card to the rollback subtree.
The production topology stages Pass 63 from its separately rebuilt dist and emits its own source-bound provenance.

requirements.summary: Known remaining hand framing and cosmetic refinements move to Pass 70
requirements.expected: Pass 69 publishes the owner-approved improved state without claiming the hands or remaining cosmetic issues are final; all new changes are isolated to Pass 70.
requirements.falsifier: Pass 69 is blocked indefinitely on the acknowledged cosmetic work, the limitations are described as complete, or Pass 70 changes enter the approved Pass 69 SHA.

deferApproval.reason: Dave judged the current build good enough to publish and explicitly assigned remaining hands and other improvements to Pass 70.

requirements.falsifier: A focused contract fails, TypeScript fails, the build fails, release provenance is weakened, or a required browser route emits a new error.
